title: Heel slide
subtitle: Bend your operated knee with control

cues.heading: Get comfortable
cues.text: Lie on your back with your operated leg straight.

cues.heading: Settle your body
cues.text: Rest your head and shoulders. Keep the other leg relaxed on the bed.

cues.heading: Slide your heel in
cues.text: Slide your heel towards your bottom, bending your operated knee.

cues.heading: Keep contact
cues.text: Keep your heel on the bed. Move within your comfortable range.

cues.heading: Slide back out
cues.text: Slowly slide your heel away until your operated leg is straight again.

cues.heading: One complete movement
cues.text: Keep your hips still. Do not force the bend or push through sharp pain.

cues.heading: Watch the slide again
cues.text: The heel stays in contact as your operated knee bends, then slides back out.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Slowly slide your heel away until your operated leg is straight again.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use the range and repetitions your physiotherapist has prescribed.

title: Straight leg raise
subtitle: Lift with your operated knee straight

cues.heading: Set your position
cues.text: Lie on your back. Bend the other knee, with that foot supported.

cues.heading: Prepare your operated leg
cues.text: Keep your operated leg straight, with your toes pointing towards the ceiling.

cues.heading: Tighten, then lift
cues.text: Tighten the thigh of your operated leg. Keep your operated knee straight as you lift.

cues.heading: Keep your operated knee straight
cues.text: Lift only a little. Keep your back relaxed and your pelvis still.

cues.heading: Lower gently
cues.text: Lower your whole operated leg slowly back onto the bed.

cues.heading: Check your control
cues.text: If your operated knee bends as you lift, stop and ask your physiotherapist.

cues.heading: Watch the lift again
cues.text: Tighten the thigh of your operated leg first. Lift your operated leg as one piece, keeping your operated knee straight.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Lower your whole operated leg slowly back onto the bed.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use your prescribed repetitions. Stop if you feel sharp pain.

cues.heading: Sit upright
cues.text: Sit on a stable chair with both feet resting on the floor.

cues.heading: Position your legs
cues.text: Keep your bottom on the seat, thighs supported and knees facing forwards.

cues.heading: Straighten your operated knee
cues.text: Lift the foot of your operated leg by slowly straightening your operated knee.

cues.heading: Keep the thigh of your operated leg supported
cues.text: Keep the thigh of your operated leg on the seat. Straighten only as far as comfortable.

cues.heading: Lower with control
cues.text: Bend your operated knee slowly and return your foot to the floor.

cues.heading: Stay steady
cues.text: Keep your body upright. Avoid swinging your operated leg or leaning backwards.

cues.heading: Watch the movement again
cues.text: The thigh stays still while the lower part of your operated leg rises. Keep your back upright.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Bend your operated knee slowly and return your foot to the floor.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use your prescribed repetitions and holds. Stop for sharp pain.

title: Quad set
subtitle: Tighten the front of the thigh of your operated leg

cues.heading: Support your operated leg
cues.text: Lie comfortably with your operated leg supported and straight.

cues.heading: Settle your position
cues.text: Keep the other knee bent and your head and shoulders relaxed.

cues.heading: Tighten the thigh of your operated leg
cues.text: Pull your toes towards you and tighten the front of the thigh of your operated leg.

cues.heading: Press gently down
cues.text: Gently press the back of your operated knee towards the bed.

cues.heading: Relax the muscle
cues.text: Release the squeeze and let the thigh of your operated leg relax completely.

cues.heading: Keep breathing
cues.text: Keep your heel supported. Breathe normally throughout the squeeze.

cues.heading: Watch the squeeze again
cues.text: Tighten the front of the thigh of your operated leg. Only a small movement may be visible.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Release the squeeze and let the thigh of your operated leg relax completely.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use the hold time and repetitions in your prescribed exercise plan.

cues.heading: Take a steady hold
cues.text: Stand tall, holding a stable worktop for support.

cues.heading: Set your stance
cues.text: Keep your feet about hip width apart and your knees facing forwards.

cues.heading: Bend behind you
cues.text: Bend your operated knee and bring that heel up behind you.

cues.heading: Keep your thighs aligned
cues.text: Keep your thighs beside each other. Avoid leaning or arching your back.

cues.heading: Return your foot
cues.text: Slowly lower your foot until it rests on the floor again.

cues.heading: Stay within your range
cues.text: Keep holding the support. Do not force the bend.

cues.heading: Watch the bend again
cues.text: The thigh stays still as the heel rises behind you. Keep holding your support.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Slowly lower your foot until it rests on the floor again.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Only do this if prescribed. Use your own repetitions and holds.

cues.heading: Hold a stable support
cues.text: Stand with feet hip width apart and hold a steady worktop.

cues.heading: Start tall and steady
cues.text: Place your feet flat. Keep your knees pointing in the same direction as your toes.

cues.heading: Make a small bend
cues.text: Bend your hips and knees a little, moving your bottom backwards.

cues.heading: Keep your feet planted
cues.text: Keep both heels down, with your knees pointing in the same direction as your toes.

cues.heading: Stand tall again
cues.text: Press through your feet and slowly straighten your hips and knees.

cues.heading: Keep it shallow
cues.text: Keep the bend shallow and comfortable. Avoid bouncing.

cues.heading: Watch the small bend again
cues.text: Move your bottom back and bend both knees a little. Keep your heels down.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Press through your feet and slowly straighten your hips and knees.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Only do this if prescribed. Follow your physiotherapist's range and repetitions.

cues.heading: Prepare your chair
cues.text: Sit towards the front of a firm, stable chair. Place both feet flat.

cues.heading: Place your feet
cues.text: Bring your feet back beneath your knees. Use the armrests if you need them.

cues.heading: Lean, then rise
cues.text: Lean forwards from your hips, then push through your feet to stand.

cues.heading: Find your balance
cues.text: Stand tall and steady. Use the armrests if you need support.

cues.heading: Sit down slowly
cues.text: Move your bottom back and lower slowly onto the chair.

cues.heading: Control the landing
cues.text: Keep your knees aligned with your toes. Avoid dropping into the seat.

cues.heading: Watch the rise again
cues.text: Bring your chest forwards over your feet, then push up into standing.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Move your bottom back and lower slowly onto the chair.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use the chair height and number of repetitions your physiotherapist recommends.

cues.heading: Set your stance
cues.text: Stand with feet hip width apart. Use a stable support if needed.

cues.heading: Prepare to move
cues.text: Keep your feet flat and your chest comfortably lifted. Look ahead.

cues.heading: Bend with control
cues.text: Move your bottom backwards as you bend your hips and knees.

cues.heading: Stay within your range
cues.text: Keep your heels down and your knees aligned with your toes.

cues.heading: Return to standing
cues.text: Push through both feet and straighten your hips and knees smoothly.

cues.heading: Choose the right depth
cues.text: Go only as low as prescribed. Do not bounce or push through sharp pain.

cues.heading: Watch the bend again
cues.text: Move back through your hips and bend both knees, keeping your feet planted.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Push through both feet and straighten your hips and knees smoothly.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Only progress to this exercise when your physiotherapist has recommended it.

cues.heading: Hold your support
cues.text: Stand beside a stable worktop and keep a hand on it.

cues.heading: Prepare your balance
cues.text: Stand tall with both feet flat. Look ahead and keep your support within reach.

cues.heading: Lift the other foot
cues.text: Shift onto your operated leg. Lift the other foot just clear of the floor.

cues.heading: Stay tall and level
cues.text: Keep your pelvis level. Look ahead and keep holding the support.

cues.heading: Put your foot down
cues.text: Gently return your lifted foot to the floor and rest.

cues.heading: Keep support close
cues.text: Do not let go until your physiotherapist says you are ready.

cues.heading: Watch the balance again
cues.text: Move your weight onto your operated leg, then lift the other foot a little.

cues.heading: Return and rest
cues.text: Gently return your lifted foot to the floor and rest.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use your prescribed hold time. Stop if you feel unsteady or dizzy.
